Social Studies.fw: Illinois Learning Standards (ILS) for Social Science (2022)

std.SS.K.CV.1: With guidance and support, identify the roles of individuals and leaders and their responsibility to meet the needs of different people and communities.
std.SS.K.CV.2: With guidance and support, identify reasons for rules and explain how rules establish responsibilities and roles for various settings.
std.SS.K-2.IS.2: With guidance and support, students will use varied teacher-selected resources to learn procedures to locate evidence that assists with finding answers to their questions. Introduce the importance of informational resources that are reliable and determine fact from opinion.
std.SS.K.H.2: Identify and describe the purpose of the national holidays of the United States, the major holidays of diverse groups, and the bravery or achievements of the diverse people that make these days special holidays.
std.SS.1.G.3: Compare how people in different types of communities use local and world-wide environments to meet their daily needs.
std.SS.K.G.1: With guidance and support, explain how weather, climate and other environmental factors affect people's lives and cultural identities in our region.
std.SS.1.EC.2: Describe the skills and knowledge required to produce certain goods and services.
std.SS.1.G.1: With guidance and support, construct and interpret print and digital maps and other cultural representations of familiar places.
std.SS.1.CV.2: Identify reasons for rules and explain how rules establish responsibilities and roles, and their effect on one's own and other groups and communities.
std.SS.1.H.2: Generate questions and investigate diverse individuals and groups who have shaped a significant historical change.
std.SS.2.G.1: With guidance and support, use print and digital maps, globes and other simple geographic models to identify cultural and environmental characteristics of places.
std.SS.2.CV.1: With guidance and support, identify features and functions of governments.
std.SS.2.EC.2: Explain the role of money in making exchange easier.
std.SS.2.EC.FL.1: Explain that money can be saved or spent on goods and services.
std.SS.2.EC.3: Compare the goods and services that people in the local community produce and those that are produced in other communities.
std.SS.2.H.2.2: Examine key events that changed history from multiple perspectives, including the perspectives of diverse individuals, cultures, and groups.
std.SS.3.H.2: Explain how the diverse perspectives of people and events develop and shape communities and/or regions.
std.SS.3.G.2: Explain how culture influences the way people modify and adapt to the environment or the way people do not modify and adapt to their environments.
std.SS.4.CV.1: Explain the roles and responsibilities of government officials at the local, state and national levels and investigate how the roles and responsibilities of government have changed over time.
std.SS.4.G.1: Construct print and digital maps and other topographic representations to show the details of places and regions and their environmental characteristics.
std.SS.5.CV.2: Examine the origins and purposes of rules, laws, and key provisions of the U.S. Constitution and investigate the impact they had/have on multiple groups of people.
std.SS.5.CV.1: Explain the roles and responsibilities of government officials at the local, state, and national levels and investigate how the roles and responsibilities of the three branches of government have changed over time.
